chapter: Learning bass and Dew Drop days
title: Blisters and buying his own bass on credit
summary: Learning through blisters, getting credit at the music store, later bass travels.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how

blocks.x: Yeah, that's what I'm saying. Well, I just jested myself and he said, well, that wasn't too bad, man. So what happened? They had blisters rolled up on my fingers, on both fingers, with blisters, you know. Oh, man. And there's a lot of, you know, like that water coming in you. And so, man, I took a pen and I busted. I said, well, Lord, I said, I've got to play tomorrow night in my hands in this condition, you know? And I said to myself, well, I guess I've got to play until I get the calluses, you know. So what happened? I come back the next night and played, next night played. Each night I got a little battered. So when I made my... I used Jared's bass for three nights. And after that, I don't know if I remember Tate, blind Tate. I used Tate bass for the next street night, blind Tate. So what happened? When I made my first payday, I went down to Swab's Music Store. There's Swab's Music Store on Dry Street, you know. So I went to Swab's and I told a man, I said, man, I like to put some bass, bass fill, you know. So he tells me, he said, well, he said, you got any credit? I said, well, I don't have no credit. I said, everything I bought, I said, it's been cash, you know.
